news.title: Forest Park Council votes 3-2 against reinstating police chief
news.summary: Forest Park City Council members voted 3-2 Monday night against reinstating ousted Police Chief Brandon Criss, leaving him locked out of his job.

news.title: Two brothers, ages 12 and 15, reported missing in Cobb County
news.summary: Cobb County police are searching for two brothers, ages 12 and 15, who ran away from home in Marietta on Nov. 13.

news.title: Georgia prison fight leaves Fulton County convict dead
news.summary: An altercation among six inmates at Dooly State Prison on Sunday left one man dead and four others injured.

news.title: 83-year-old killed in Kennesaw crash over the weekend
news.summary: The driver was taken to the hospital but died, according to police.

news.title: How a former Honduran diplomat allegedly extorted $375K from travelers
news.summary: Federal prosecutors arrested former Honduran Consul General Ada Evila Serrano Nuñez and three co-conspirators in Atlanta.

news.title: Morehouse student arrested after rape allegation as college faces scrutiny over sexual misconduct
news.summary: A Morehouse College student has been arrested following an allegation of rape off campus, adding to growing concerns about sexual misconduct at schools in Atlanta’s university center.

news.title: GBI assisting with death investigation in Bartow County
news.summary: The GBI confirmed Monday that it was asked by the sheriff's office to assist with the investigation.

news.title: Former Norcross officer charged with misusing license plate reader
news.summary: A former Norcross Police Department officer is facing four criminal charges after Georgia Bureau of Investigation agents accused him of improperly accessing a license plate reader database.

news.title: 19-year-old killed in Gainesville shooting identified
news.summary: Gainesville police are investigating the fatal shooting of 19-year-old Daniel Alvarado Carmona after officers found him unresponsive inside a vehicle on Thursday at Paces Court.

news.title: Ex-Norcross officer facing charges over misuse of Flock system
news.summary: It's one among several in a string of recent arrests in metro Atlanta by law enforcement personnel accused of misusing license plate reader systems.

news.summary: No injuries were reported and the business was not open at the time, police said.
